overview.Description: Global Net Lease, Inc. is a publicly traded internally managed real estate investment trust that focuses on acquiring and managing a global portfolio of income producing net lease assets across the U.S., and Western and Northern Europe. Global Net Lease, Inc. was incorporated in 2011 and is based in New York, United States.
